raw_plan.reader: A product manager or product team lead who needs usable feature requests collected from customer conversations for product review, without adding another manual triage queue.
raw_plan.reader_segment: Product manager or product team lead at a software company
raw_plan.reader_scope: Product teams evaluating whether Canny can automatically turn feedback in call transcripts, support tickets, chats, and reviews into deduplicated requests routed to the appropriate team. Do not assume a particular source, incumbent platform, or existing workflow.
raw_plan.promise: Canny can take on the repetitive work of capturing, deduplicating, and triaging feature requests from customer conversations, and the team can begin with the $0 Free plan.
raw_plan.orientation: Canny is a feedback management tool that pulls feature requests out of support tickets, sales calls, chats, and reviews, deduplicates them, and triages them for product teams.
raw_plan.arc: In one email, move the reader from seeing Canny as another feedback inbox that their team would have to maintain to seeing Autopilot as a way to automate the capture, deduplication, and triage work, with a $0 Free plan as the first step.
raw_plan.sequence_rationale: One email should make one complete case: the product's automatic workflow directly answers the main objection that another tool will create more manual triage. The $0 Free plan reduces the commitment required to test that operational value, but it supports rather than replaces the reason to adopt. The single thing that would most change this campaign is a readable copy of the unavailable source page or verification of its missing details.

value_case.mechanism: Autopilot reads call transcripts, support tickets, and reviews, pulls out feature requests, merges detected duplicates, and triages feedback to the appropriate team.

If feedback reaches you through call transcripts, support tickets, or reviews, connect one source. Autopilot reads those conversations, pulls out feature requests, merges detected duplicates, and triages the feedback to the right team.

Canny is customer feedback management software that brings those requests into one place. Your product team receives the useful request—not just the full conversation—with the repetitive capture, deduplication, and triage already handled.

Start with Canny’s **$0/month Free plan**, billed yearly. It includes 25 tracked users—users associated with feedback—so you can connect an existing source and decide whether Autopilot belongs in your feedback workflow.
